prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application design comp for TravelCanvas, 1440 × 1000 first viewport
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only. Inherit its restrained warm Chinese travel palette, typography character, thin bordered form controls, and quiet professional component character. Do not copy its layout, content structure, or wording.
Primary request: Design a polished Chinese desktop travel-planning web app first viewport optimized for the fastest possible start. This is a real product UI mockup, not a poster.
Scene/backdrop: warm sand page background (#f6f4ee), generous but efficient spacing, centered maximum-width application canvas, no conventional navigation menu.
Composition/framing:
- Exact 1440 × 1000 desktop viewport, straight-on screenshot, full-width application.
- A restrained top brand bar only: left wordmark “TRAVELCANVAS” with a small terracotta label “中国旅行规划”; right understated reassurance text “真实地点 · 路线可验证”.
- Main hero area begins immediately below. Left-aligned large headline “下一站，现在就开始规划”, with one concise supporting line: “选好目的地，真实地点与路线马上呈现。”
- Directly beneath the headline, one horizontal, lightly elevated departure console. It contains four clearly separated compact fields in one row: “目的地” with value “杭州”; “出发日期” with value “2026/09/18”; “行程” with value “2天”; “同行” with value “2人”. At the far right, a prominent tea-mountain green primary button with exact text “开始发现”.
- Under the console, a quiet collapsed disclosure row with chevron and exact text “补充预算、偏好与餐饮要求”. Keep this subordinate and obviously expandable.
- The lower half of the viewport previews section “真实地点候选” with supporting microcopy “由公开来源发现，并经地图数据核验”. Include a small “杭州 · 初步预览” tag.
- Show exactly three travel place cards in one horizontal row. Each card has a low-detail abstract destination color block or elegant line-art thumbnail, never a real photograph. Card titles: “西湖风景名胜区”, “灵隐寺”, “中国茶叶博物馆”. Add only concise factual category/location lines, not ratings or prices. Each card includes a source/status footer such as “高德地图 · 已核验” and a small query-time label “刚刚查询”. The cards suggest selectable candidates with a subtle square selection control.
Style/medium: highly polished production-ready UI/UX screenshot, premium editorial travel tool, precise professional interaction design, Chinese-first typography, subtle 1px borders, 12–16px radii, soft restrained elevation only for the departure console and candidate hover/selected character.
Color palette: tea-mountain green #226054, terracotta orange #df7255, warm sand #f6f4ee, rice paper #fffdf8, pine ink #18322e. Pale desaturated green may be used for verified status surfaces. No other dominant hues.
Typography: confident large Chinese headline with refined editorial character; compact modern sans-serif for controls and metadata; strong legibility and deliberate hierarchy.
Lighting/mood: calm daylight, efficient, trustworthy, premium, inviting immediate action.
Text (verbatim): “TRAVELCANVAS”, “中国旅行规划”, “真实地点 · 路线可验证”, “下一站，现在就开始规划”, “选好目的地，真实地点与路线马上呈现。”, “目的地”, “杭州”, “出发日期”, “2026/09/18”, “行程”, “2天”, “同行”, “2人”, “开始发现”, “补充预算、偏好与餐饮要求”, “真实地点候选”, “由公开来源发现，并经地图数据核验”, “杭州 · 初步预览”, “西湖风景名胜区”, “灵隐寺”, “中国茶叶博物馆”, “高德地图 · 已核验”, “刚刚查询”.
Constraints: Make the first action instantly obvious. Preserve ample whitespace without wasting vertical space. Use realistic form affordances and consistent alignment. Candidate preview must be visible within the first 1000px viewport. Do not invent ratings, reviews, prices, availability, endorsements, or factual claims beyond the labels above. No realistic place photos. The output must look implementable in Next.js/CSS.
Avoid: conventional navigation tabs, sidebar, admin dashboard, metric cards, analytics wall, dense multi-step form, generic AI-product styling, purple or blue gradients, glassmorphism, neon, excessive shadows, oversized decorative illustration, poster composition, phone mockup, browser chrome, perspective view, floating 3D objects, fake star ratings, fake prices, fake testimonials, watermarks.
